# Frozen reviewed upstream source modules (2026-11-07)

This folder contains exact-SHA snapshots of selected source modules for offline inspection and later controlled internal maintenance. They are NOT integrated with the runnable application or approved for trading. Upstream sources are frozen; no automatic update, sync or tracking.

- Aurum: zero-was-here/tradingbot @ 39c33b49237e0f290f89bda18e27aa4e75021c03, MIT. Preserve vendor license and attribution.
- TradingAgents: TauricResearch/TradingAgents @ 9fa1196fffbcfd9de5146d2dd2869df84ab99838, Apache-2.0. Preserve vendor license and attribution.

Some modules have additional dependencies not included in this curated snapshot; integration is subject to a dependency audit, tests, and source inventory. Do not execute as-is.
